tips.label: 授與動詞
tips.text: 人先物後：give 人 物，不填介系詞（×）。物先人後：give 物 to 人；buy 物 for 人。

tips.label: Why 的用法
tips.text: 問原因用 Why；be 動詞放主詞前，一般動詞用 do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形動詞。

tips.label: Because 和 So
tips.text: because 後接原因；so 後接結果。同一組因果子句不要同時用 because 和 so。

tips.label: Because 和 Because of
tips.text: because + 主詞 + 動詞；because of + 名詞或名詞片語。

notes.title: 授與動詞的兩種句型
notes.rule: S + V + 人 + 物；S + V + 物 + to／for + 人
notes.description: give、send、show、write、pass 的物在前時用 to；buy、make、cook 用 for。人直接放在動詞後、物放最後時，不加介系詞，題目以 × 表示不填。例如 Mom bought me × a coat；改成物在前則是 Mom bought a coat for me。人稱代名詞當受詞時用 me、him、her、us、them。本課物用 it／them 時，採「物＋to／for＋人」。
examples: Mom bought a coat for me.
The nurse gave Amy some medicine.
The nurse gave some medicine to Amy.

notes.title: Why 的用法
notes.rule: Why + be 動詞 + 主詞 ...?；Why + do／does／did + 主詞 + 原形動詞 ...?
notes.description: Why 問原因。問狀態時將 be 動詞放主詞前；問一般動詞的動作時用 do、does 或 did。did／did not 後面的動詞都用原形。回答可用 Because + 原因子句。
examples: Why does Tom wear a mask every day?
Why did you call the doctor?
Why didn't Amy take her medicine?

notes.title: Because 和 So 的因果順序
notes.rule: 結果 + because + 原因；Because + 原因, 結果；原因, so + 結果
notes.description: because 帶出原因，so 帶出結果。because 子句放句首時，後面用逗號分開。同一組因果子句不寫成 Because ..., so ...。
examples: I stayed home because I had a fever.
Because I had a fever, I stayed home.
I had a fever, so I stayed home.

notes.title: Because 和 Because of 的差別
notes.rule: because + 子句；because of + 名詞／名詞片語
notes.description: 先看後面有沒有主詞與動詞。he was sick 是完整子句，用 because；his illness 是名詞片語，用 because of。不能只看中文都譯為「因為」就混用。
examples: Tom missed school because he had a fever.
Tom missed school because of his fever.
Because the weather was bad, we stayed home.
Because of the bad weather, we stayed home.

quiz.question: My uncle sent me ___ a message about his health.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: send＋人＋物，人 me 在前，物 a message 在後，不加介系詞。

quiz.question: The nurse showed the children ___ a clean mask.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: show＋人＋物，the children 在物品前，不需要介系詞。

quiz.question: Mom cooked my brother ___ some rice after his fever went down.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: cook＋人＋物，my brother 後直接接 some rice。

quiz.question: Dad bought his daughter ___ a new coat.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: buy＋人＋物，his daughter 在前時不用 for。

quiz.question: This note is for the nurse. Please pass it ___ her.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: pass＋物＋to＋人；it 是物，her 是接收者。

quiz.question: This message is for Dad. Please send it ___ him.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: send＋物＋to＋收件人；it 是訊息，him 是收件人。

quiz.question: The masks are for the students. Please give them ___ the students.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: give＋物＋to＋人；them 指 masks，放在人前面要加 to。

quiz.question: My sister made a warm scarf ___ me for winter.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: make＋物＋for＋人，表示為某人製作物品。

quiz.question: Dad bought some medicine ___ his sick son.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: buy＋物＋for＋人，表示為某人買東西。

quiz.question: We cooked a healthy meal ___ Grandma.（× 表示不填介系詞。）
quiz.hint: cook＋物＋for＋人，表示為某人煮食物。

quiz.question: My brother gave ___ a glass of warm water.
quiz.hint: give 後面的人稱代名詞是受詞，使用 me。

quiz.question: The teacher sent ___ a message about our health.
quiz.hint: send 後的人是受詞，we 要改為 us。

quiz.question: The nurse showed ___ how to put on their masks.
quiz.hint: show 後的人稱代名詞用受格 them。

quiz.question: These clothes are for the baby. Please give ___ to his mother.
quiz.hint: 空格指複數 clothes，且是 give 的受詞，使用 them。

quiz.question: This soup is for my grandfather. I cooked it for ___.
quiz.hint: for 後接受格 him；句子主詞是 I，不能用反身代名詞 himself 指 grandfather。

quiz.question: This mask is clean. Please give ___ to the child.
quiz.hint: 空格指單數 mask，作 give 的受詞，用 it。

quiz.question: A: ___ did you put on a mask? B: Because I caught a cold.
quiz.hint: 回答 Because 說明原因，問句應用 Why。

quiz.question: Why ___ your feet so cold now?
quiz.hint: feet 是複數，cold 是形容詞，現在式用 are。

quiz.question: Why ___ your sister at the hospital yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 指過去，your sister 是單數，問所在位置用 was。

quiz.question: Why ___ the boys so tired after the game last night?
quiz.hint: last night 指過去，主詞 the boys 是複數，狀態用 were。

quiz.question: Why ___ the nurse call your mother every morning?
quiz.hint: call 是一般動詞；every morning 表示習慣，單數主詞用 does。

quiz.question: Why ___ you stay in bed all day yesterday?
quiz.hint: yesterday 是過去時間，stay 是原形動詞，問句用 did。

quiz.question: Why does your uncle ___ a coat indoors every day?
quiz.hint: 助動詞 does 後接原形動詞 wear。

quiz.question: Why did the doctor ___ your arm yesterday?
quiz.hint: Did 後用原形 check，不能再用過去式。

quiz.question: Why didn't your sister ___ the nurse last night?
quiz.hint: didn't 後面接原形 call。

quiz.question: Why do your parents ___ so much about your health?
quiz.hint: 助動詞 do 後面接原形 worry。

quiz.question: Why ___ your shoulder so sore right now?
quiz.hint: shoulder 是單數，sore 是形容詞，用 is 問現在狀態。

quiz.question: Why ___ the children wash their hands before every meal?
quiz.hint: the children 是複數，wash 是一般動詞，習慣問句用 do。

quiz.question: Why didn't the boy ___ his coat before going outside?
quiz.hint: didn't 後接原形動詞片語 put on。

quiz.question: A: Why is your brother resting? B: ___ he has a headache.
quiz.hint: Why 問原因，回答用 Because＋主詞＋動詞。

quiz.question: ___ my stomach hurt, I went to see a doctor.
quiz.hint: my stomach hurt 是原因子句，句首先用 Because 引出原因。

quiz.question: My hands were dirty, ___ I washed them before eating.
quiz.hint: 手髒是原因，洗手是結果，用 so 連接結果。

quiz.question: Because Dad had a fever, ___ he stayed in bed.（× 表示不填連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 句首已有 Because，同一組因果子句不再使用 so。

quiz.question: I couldn't speak loudly because ___.
options: C. of my throat was sore
quiz.hint: because 後接主詞＋動詞，my throat was sore 是完整子句。

quiz.question: ___ the medicine made me sleepy, I went to bed early.
quiz.hint: 藥讓我想睡是原因，完整原因子句前用 Because。

quiz.question: The child couldn't reach the coat, ___ his father helped him.
quiz.hint: 拿不到外套是原因，爸爸幫忙是結果，使用 so。

quiz.question: Because her leg hurt, ___ Amy took a taxi home.（× 表示不填連接詞。）
quiz.hint: Because 已連接原因與結果，逗號後不重複加 so。

quiz.question: ___ the baby felt cold, Mom gave him a blanket.
quiz.hint: 寶寶覺得冷是給毯子的原因，完整子句前用 Because。

quiz.question: Because I caught a cold, ___ I wore a mask to class.（× 表示不填連接詞。）
quiz.hint: 同一組因果子句使用 Because 時，結果前不再加 so。

quiz.question: Grandpa's knee hurt, ___ he couldn't walk to the store.
quiz.hint: 膝蓋痛是原因，無法走到商店是結果，使用 so。

quiz.question: The students stayed indoors because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語，the bad weather 符合；其他都是子句。

quiz.question: My sister missed the party because ___.
options: B. of she had a fever
quiz.hint: because 後需要主詞與動詞，she had a fever 是子句。

quiz.question: The boy couldn't sleep because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 his headache。

quiz.question: We called the nurse because ___.
options: D. of the baby was sick
quiz.hint: because 後用完整子句 the baby was sick。

quiz.question: The player missed the game because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 his sore knee，不接完整子句。

quiz.question: Mom made me some soup because ___.
options: D. I had a sore throat
quiz.hint: because 後接主詞 I 與動詞 had 構成的原因子句。

quiz.question: ___ her stomachache, May didn't eat lunch.
quiz.hint: her stomachache 是名詞片語，用 Because of。

quiz.question: ___ his arm hurt, Ben couldn't carry his bag.
quiz.hint: his arm hurt 有主詞與動詞，是完整子句，用 Because。

quiz.question: The trip was canceled because of ___.
quiz.hint: because of 後接名詞片語 the heavy rain。

quiz.question: The girl stayed home because ___.
quiz.hint: because 後接完整子句 she caught a cold。

grammar.sentence_chinese: 媽媽買了一件外套給我旅行時穿。

grammar.sentence: Why does your brother take medicine every day?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你哥哥為什麼每天吃藥？

grammar.sentence: The boy couldn't sleep because of his headache.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個男孩因為頭痛而睡不著。

grammar.sentence: The teacher showed us a picture of a heart.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 老師給我們看了一張心臟的圖片。

grammar.sentence: Because the baby felt cold, Mom held him.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為寶寶覺得冷，媽媽抱著他。

grammar.sentence: Why didn't you put on your warm coat?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你為什麼沒有穿上你的保暖外套？

grammar.sentence: Grandma cooked a healthy meal for the children.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 奶奶為孩子們煮了一頓健康的餐點。

grammar.sentence: I caught a cold, so I wore a mask.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我感冒了，所以戴了口罩。

grammar.sentence: Why was your sister at the hospital yesterday?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 你姐姐昨天為什麼在醫院？

grammar.sentence: We missed the game because of the heavy rain.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 我們因為大雨而錯過了比賽。

grammar.sentence: The nurse gave him a glass of water.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 護士給了他一杯水。

grammar.sentence: Why do the children wash their hands before lunch?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 孩子們為什麼在午餐前洗手？

grammar.sentence: She went to bed early because she felt sick.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她因為覺得不舒服而提早上床睡覺。

grammar.sentence: Please pass the warm blanket to your grandfather.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 請把那條溫暖的毯子遞給你爺爺。

grammar.sentence: Because of his sore arm, Ben couldn't swim.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為手臂痠痛，Ben 無法游泳。

grammar.sentence: Why were the players so tired last night?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那些球員昨晚為什麼那麼累？

grammar.sentence: Her leg hurt, so we called a taxi.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 她的腿痛，所以我們叫了計程車。

grammar.sentence: My sister made a scarf for our mother.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 姐姐為我們的媽媽做了一條圍巾。

grammar.sentence: Why did the doctor check the baby's neck?
grammar.sentence_chinese: 醫生為什麼檢查寶寶的脖子？

grammar.sentence: Because I had a fever, I missed school.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 因為我發燒，所以沒去上學。

grammar.sentence: This medicine is for Grandpa. Please give it to him.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 這個藥是給爺爺的。請把它給他。

grammar.sentence: The girl stayed inside because of the cold weather.
grammar.sentence_chinese: 那個女孩因為天氣寒冷而待在室內。
